scope.method: 只读静态阅读；未运行客户端、未抓包、未联网、未 sudo

fields.name: info.stid

fields.name: info.value
fields.meaning: 朗读原文（HTML 片段）。朗读题的标准答案就是原文本身（评分由录音引擎与服务端比对）

iframe_web/js/pc-listen-data.js:61 "value":"

At this time of year, there are still only five hours of daylight. ..." ；iframe_web/pc-listen-answer.html:37

fields.name: info.video
fields.meaning: 视频素材（content.mp4）

fields.meaning: 图片素材，A1 为空

fields.name: info.symbol
fields.meaning: 原文的逐词标注版；答案页已注释掉

fields.name: info.ai
fields.meaning: value 的断句版（每行尾插入 </br>）；两端 0 消费者

iframe_web/js/pc-listen-data.js:61 "ai":"

At this time of year, there are still only five hours of
daylight. ..." ；grep -rn '\.ai\b' iframe_web/ -> 0 命中

fields.meaning: 译文，A1 为空，答案页 translate_con 未绑定

fields.meaning: 解析，A1 为空

fields.meaning: 运行时注入的显示号（非内容包字段）
